description: A bed with a dark blue sheet and a pale pink pillow is in front, with a gray piece of cloth lying near the center. The right hand reaches in to grasp the cloth, then both hands lift and spread it open as a two-hand object before laying it back down; the hands smooth it flat, fold the sides inward into a long strip, and then fold the strip over again into a smaller rectangle, releasing it neatly on the bed.
